subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: Should `openclaw doctor` add a final composed gateway diagnosis model for mixed service/runtime/channel states, including an optional machine-readable diagnosis block?
rationale: Current main already collects most raw facts, but precedence between RPC, service, config drift, and channel conflicts plus the public output shape are stable CLI UX choices that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Add composed doctor verdict
options.body: Render one healthy/degraded/down final diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing gateway, service, and channel facts.

options.title: Refine separate panels only
options.body: Keep the current independent panels and improve misleading strings after live macOS proof narrows the confusing transcript.

options.title: Design structured diagnosis first
options.body: Define a compact diagnosis object before rendering prose and optional JSON from that object in follow-up implementation.

recommendation.title: Add composed doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Render one healthy/degraded/down final diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing gateway, service, and channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses doctor, gateway probe, service lifecycle, and CLI UX surfaces where steipete has adjacent feature-history commits and was already routed in the issue timeline.
